evidence.claim: The flagged transaction 3514030 is a $77.07 in-person (product code W) purchase in billing region 444.0 at 2016-12-04 19:55:28, on a debit card whose modal region is 204.0.
Region 444.0 is known to this card: 10 prior purchases over 9 distinct days between 2016-09-13 and 2016-11-26, with a hint of 'known' rather than 'new' or 'rare'.

The bank's convention still labels card-present fraud away from the card's modal region (204.0) as out_of_region_use even when the specific region is one the card has used repeatedly (10 prior uses here), since 581 of 955 of the bank's confirmed out_of_region_use closed cases involved regions used five or more times before.
$77.07 fits the card's baseline as of opening: 358 prior transactions, prior median amount $83.94, prior maximum $845.01.

The 72h window around the flagged transaction shows 9 in-person purchases across seven different regions (433.0, 204.0, 191.0, 204.0, 433.0, 485.0, 203.0, 444.0, 203.0), all product code W, no online activity and no mixed channel, consistent with this card's ordinary multi-region roaming (40 regions used all-time).
The flagged transaction's cms_p of 0.2245 is 30-160x higher than every other transaction in its 48h episode chain, whose cms_p values range from 0.001375 to 0.008138.
This card has four prior confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3587, CC-2964, CC-1673, CC-1066), most recently opened 2016-09-17, three labeled out_of_region_use and one card_not_present_new_device.

case.summary: Verdict legitimate at probability 0.10: the $77.07 in-person purchase in region 444.0 flagged by risk score 0.61 sits inside the card's baseline, and the customer confirmed recognizing the charge and travel to that region. Exposure is $0.00 with no episode transactions retained; the case was opened per 3a and then closed since confirmation resolved the single history-based signal (an alternative reading, treating the region as merely "known" rather than a genuine trip, would have kept it uncertain). Recommended actions: CREATE_CASE and ALLOW_TRANSACTION (auto), CLOSE_NO_FRAUD (auto).
